insight: Keeps embeddings in the same Postgres as your relational data, so you can JOIN against them and back everything up together.
name: pgvector
tagline: Vector similarity search inside Postgres. The pragmatic default.
description: Postgres extension that adds a vector type plus exact and approximate nearest-neighbour search. Pairs naturally with Supabase, Neon, and any managed Postgres. The lowest-friction RAG backend if you already run Postgres.
